name: Hranit
source:
Generation after generation live turbulent years, create history. Dreams of a free future turn into a struggle in the mouth of the revolution.

[s]But every action has its consequences.[/s]

Anna Orestivna seemed to live a happy life: she has her own home, hobbies, favorite job... If only it wasn't 2023.

She is waiting for her son to return. A delicious dinner, love and warmth - all this the woman prepared for him. Or maybe for yourself?
